Paulus, vinctus Iesu Christi: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus
et Timotheus frater Philemoni dilecto: and Timothy, a brother: to Philemon, our beloved
et Apie sorori carissime: And to Appia, our dearest sister
et Archippo commilitoni nostro: and to Archippus, our fellow soldier
et Ecclesie que in domo tua est,: and to the church which is in thy house
audiens caritatem tuam et fidem: Hearing of thy charity and faith
habes in Domino Iesu: thou hast in the Lord Jesus
QUAM HABES IN DOMINO IESU ET IN OMNES SA: which thou hast in the Lord Jesus, and towards all the saints
ut communicatio fidei tue: That the communication of thy faith
IN AGNITIONES OMNIS BONI IN CHRISTO IESU: in the acknowledgment of every good work, that is in you in Christ Jesus
evidens fiat in agnitione omnis boni in: may be made evident in the acknowledgment of every good work, that is in you in Christ Jesus.
Gaudium enim magnum habui: For I have had great joy
tibi quod ad rem pertinet: thee that which is to the purpose
cum sis talis: whereas thou art such a one
te pro meo filio quem genui: thee for my son, whom I have begotten
qui tibi aliquando: Who hath been heretofore unprofitable to thee
fuit, nunc autem et mihi et tibi utilis,: hath been, but now is profitable both to me and thee
Tu autem illum ut mea viscera: And do thou receive him as my own bowels
enim ideo discessit ad horam a te: For he therefore departed for a season from thee
ut in eternum: that thou mightest receive him again for ever
servo, carissimum fratrem: a servant, a most dear brother
Quanto autem magis tibi: but how much more to thee
me a partner, receive him as myself.
Ego Paulus scripsi mea manu. Ego reddam: I Paul have written it with my own hand: I will repay it
that thou owest me thy own self also.
May I enjoy thee in the Lord.
obedientia tua scripsi tibi, sciens quon: thy obedience, I have written to thee: knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
